annotations.title: Connect a sheet by its link

description: Makes a Google Sheet the person already has into one of their tracks, from its link, so hacks can write to it: a copy of a template sheet (like a budget someone shared) keeps its own tabs and formulas; any other sheet gets the tabs a track writes to beside its own. Google lets TrackerHacker open a sheet only once the person confirms it, so this usually gives back a confirm_link: send it to the person, who taps one button and picks the sheet in Google's picker, then call list_tracks to see it. If the sheet is already shared as Editor with TrackerHacker's service account, it's connected at once. Show an email address they'll copy in a code block (it gets a copy button), and each long link as a named Markdown link, like [Your sheet](https://...).

link.description: The sheet's link (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/...) or its id.

name.description: The track's name. Leave out for the sheet's title.

schemaId.description: For a sheet that isn't a template copy: what it tracks, a schema id. Transactions when left out.
